edges.reason: tx.origin from the constructor flows into the governance assignment, letting phishing/tx.origin tricks capture ownership
The unsafe tx.origin assignment writes the governance state variable
governance is read inside setGovernance to authorize the caller
msg.sender decides whether setGovernance executes
setGovernance overwrites the governance state variable
New governance address parameter is written to the governance slot
governance is read inside addMinter for authorization
msg.sender decides whether addMinter executes
addMinter writes true into the minters privileges mapping
governance is read inside removeMinter for authorization
msg.sender decides whether removeMinter executes
removeMinter revokes minter privilege in the minters mapping
minters mapping is read to authorize the mint caller
msg.sender indexes the minters mapping in mint
mint delegates execution to _mint
Mint recipient parameter flows into _mint account
Mint amount parameter flows into _mint arithmetic on balances and total supply
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances
_mint increases _totalSupply
msg.sender is returned by _msgSender
transfer calls _msgSender to resolve the sender
Debited sender parameter flows into _transfer
Credited recipient parameter flows into _transfer
Transfer amount parameter flows into balance subtraction and addition
_transfer rewrites entries of _balances
Allowance owner parameter flows into _approve
Allowance spender parameter flows into _approve
Allowance amount parameter flows into allowance arithmetic
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _approve to decrement allowance
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level token call
Low-level call result is captured in the success local variable
Low-level call return payload is captured in returndata
Malicious token invoked by the low-level call can reenter transfer before state settles
Malicious token invoked by the low-level call can reenter transferFrom and mutate allowance/balances

Parameter amount is only used in the mint arithmetic of _mint
Parameter _governance is only assigned to the governance state variable in setGovernance
Parameter _minter is only written into the minters mapping in addMinter
Parameter sender is only used to debit _balances inside _transfer
Parameter recipient is only used to credit _balances inside _transfer
Parameter amount is only used in the balance arithmetic of _transfer
Parameter owner is only used as the _allowances key inside _approve
Parameter spender is only used as the _allowances key inside _approve
Parameter amount is only used as the allowance value inside _approve
